Alyssa (Sec): Heads-up: we're rolling out a policy to retire long-lived SSH deploy keys and repo-level SSH secrets. Enforcement begins 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC. Please read and act.
sec-bot: Org scan 2026-03-11 03:05 UTC -> 58 repositories with SSH keys present in secrets or variables. See internal report: https://go/internal/ssh-secrets-scan
Carlos (Infra): What migration options are supported? We have a mix of GitHub, GitLab, and on-prem CI runners.
Alyssa (Sec): Recommended paths:
- Use Vault SSH dynamic certs (preferred) via our CA: generates short-lived user/host certs.
- For GitHub Actions/GitLab CI, exchange SSH keys for ephemeral sessions using `vault ssh` wrapper or `ssh-agent` with signed certs.
- For on-prem runners, we'll ship an agent that fetches certs from Vault using instance identity.
Priya (CI): Any example for GitHub Actions? We still have deploy jobs that SSH to bastion.
Alyssa (Sec): Example (Actions snippet):
```
- name: Get short-lived SSH cert
  run: |
    VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault login -method=github token=$VAULT_TOKEN
    vault write -format=json ssh-client-signer/sign/my-role public_key=@~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub ttl=30m > cert.json
    cat cert.json | jq -r .data.signed_key > ~/.ssh/id_rsa-cert.pub
- name: Use cert
  run: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o CertificateFile=~/.ssh/id_rsa-cert.pub user@bastion
```
Emily (SRE): For Buildkite we can add a small step that requests a cert just-in-time. Do we have a client binary? Docker image?
Dave (Platform): Yes, `redwood/vault-ssh-init:latest` image is available. It uses instance identity token to mint a cert, stores it in a temp agent, and cleans up. Docs: https://go/internal/vault-ssh-init
sec-bot: Quick mitigation: created a read-only report and opened issues in repos with highest deploy frequency. Pager duty list attached.
Carlos (Infra): Enforcement behavior? Will CI fail noisily?
Alyssa (Sec): Enforcement timeline:
- 2026-03-25 - notify repo owners (done)
- 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC - org policy blocks usage of SSH deploy keys in repo secrets; pipelines that still reference them will fail to retrieve secrets.
- 2026-04-14 - any remaining keys will be revoked and rotated by security team.
Failures will show "secret access denied" or "key revoked" in CI logs. We'll provide a 48h emergency exception path.
Priya (CI): Exception process?
Alyssa (Sec): Submit at https://go/internal/sec-exceptions with: service owner, reason, expected migration date. Approved by infra oncall + sec lead.
Emily (SRE): Do we have an automated migration helper? Opening 58 PRs manually will be painful.
sec-bot: Tool available: `tools/ssh-secret_rewrite.py --repo <org/repo>` will detect legacy secrets, create a branch with a suggested workflow change, and open a PR. It does not auto-merge. Use with review.
Carlos (Infra): I'll run the tool on prod-critical repos and post PR links here.
Priya (CI): Any impacts to runbooks or incident playbooks we should update?
Alyssa (Sec): Yes, SRE/Oncall runbooks updated: https://go/internal/runbooks/ssh-cert-migration. Add a step to re-request certs and to call infra-support if you need a temporary exception.
Dave (Platform): Note: rotate any service accounts that had access to create static keys. Audit bindings: `scripts/audit_ssh_key_owners.sh`.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly digest and enforcement countdown - 2 weeks remaining.
Priya (CI): Acknowledged. Scheduling migration windows next Tue/Thu.
Emily (SRE): Will validate on canary services and verify post-deploy auth.
Carlos (Infra): Posting first PR list by EOD.
Alyssa (Sec): Thanks all. After enforcement we'll publish a short postmortem summary of any issues encountered. If you need help, DM me or tag @infra-oncall. :lock:
